description: An organization from a Rest deployment, registered here so a purchase made without an app session still has an identity to settle against. One row per (deployment, organization): it names the Customer Group the organization bills under, keeps a Customer for each of its funding groups, and owns the link slug that ties a public purchase-form submission to this organization. The slug is the document's name, so an attributed link can never resolve to two rows.

fields.label: Link Slug
fields.description: The opaque token in an attributed purchase link — ?org=<slug>. Read-only and unique because it IS the document's name: a link that names two organizations would settle a payment against the wrong one. Generated once at registration and never edited.

fields.label: Rest Instance
fields.description: The deployment the organization belongs to. Part of the row's identity: the app's organization and group ids are per-deployment, so two deployments may legitimately share an id and must never share a row.

fields.label: Organization Id
fields.description: The organization's own id in its Rest deployment, exactly as the app sends it.

fields.label: Organization
fields.description: Display name, for the desk. An operator's rename in the app travels on the next registration; this field is filled from what the app sends and is never edited here.
The ERPNext Customer Group this organization's invoices are grouped under. One per organization, so a per-church statement is one view.
fields.label: Customer Group
Default Funding Group Id
fields.description: The funding group a public-form purchase credits when the buyer arrived without one named — normally the organization's root group, sent by the app when it asks for the purchase link. Without this, a form purchase has nowhere to put its credits and is refused rather than guessed at.

fields.label: Default Funding Group
fields.description: The default group's display name, for the desk.

One row per funding group that has ever bought credits. The Customer is the billing entity — credits belong to the group that pays for them, so the invoice names the group's Customer, not the organization's.
fields.label: Funding Groups

name: Rest Credit Organization
